what: On first open, the logo group rises over an opposite-color curtain in .8s (power1.out), and several different logo sets swap one set at a time over 1.4s (1.4/count seconds per set). When done, the curtain turns to the background color and the logo to the text color over .6s (power2.in). .5s later the logo exits 20% upward over 1s (power2.in), and meanwhile the curtain, .1s late, folds upward over 1.2s (power2.out) to height 0. Coming back in the same window, it starts with the background-color curtain and text-color logo, holds .5s, then the logo clears over .5s and the curtain fades to transparent over .84s. At the moment it clears, fx:done fires.

options.loop: Duration of one full logo swap cycle (sec), default 1.4
options.tint: Overlay and logo color change (s), default .6
options.hold: Hold after color change before folding (s), default .5
options.lift: Duration of logo moving up and out (s), default 1
options.collapse: Curtain fold duration (seconds), default 1.2 — .7x when it returns
options.key: sessionStorage name used to remember a return visit, default kfLogoCycleLoader · ”none” always acts like the first visit
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Curtain (--kf-contrast-bg at first, --kf-bg at the end)
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: One logo set (multiple — when stacked, one set turns on at a time)

from.where: index.html .pg-loader (first page loader — original loading_logo_item ×15 · totalLoopDuration 1.4 · panelCollapseDuration 1.2 · hasPageLoaded remembered per session)

note: When it ends, the board is set to display:none and fx:done is fired — the hero entrance hooks onto that event (in the original it is the loadingDone marker on the same timeline)
